title: Egypt Arrests 6 Matsaddash Journalists on Claims of Spreading Disinformation
summary_full: The government claims that reporters from Matsaddash, a well-known news outlet that debunks false reports, spread disinformation for the banned Muslim Brotherhood.
summary_public: The government claims that reporters from Matsaddash, a well-known news outlet that debunks false reports, spread disinformation for the banned Muslim Brotherhood.
